canonical_project: GTA GU3 / Alupang Data Center and Cable Landing Station (Tamuning)
notes: GTA official page: GU3 designed to Tier 3 specification, 32,000+ sq ft, 4 MW, serves as data center and cable landing station, 'ready for equipment in Q3 2025' - no official commissioning evidence found as of 2026-08-12, so kept construction. DCD/PostGuam (B): Alupang Data Center groundbreaking Oct 2022 in Tamuning, ~31,000 sq ft, 4 MW, completion expected late 2024; Baxtel (C) lists the site as 'GTA: Alupang GU3', identifying Alupang as GU3.
